title: PoppyOperationResult
description: structuredContent of an MCP tool error result (isError true) that asks for approval before performing a write skill. Operations extension version 3, section 4 (MCP). Returned only to a Personal Agent whose request declares the extension; ordinary MCP clients never receive it. The HTTP API equivalent is poppy-approval-required.schema.json. Other members are allowed.
$comment: Adapted from personal-agent-protocol at 8c02b4282eda53468a7c09412558bc8b060d95f6 (Apache-2.0); unmodified independent fixtures and hashes in tests/upstream/poppy/published-1.0. JSON Schema does not verify cryptography or runtime requirements.
